citation.authors: Bertrand KA, Delp L, Coogan PF, Cozier YC et al

record.population: 44,798 Black women with an intact uterus in the Black Women's Health Study; 347 uterine cancers
record.finding: Heavy use (15 or more years, at least 5 times a year) against never or light use gave a hazard ratio of 1.18 (95% CI 0.81-1.71), not significant. Among postmenopausal women, heavy use was 1.64 (1.01-2.64) and 20 or more years of use 1.71 (1.08-2.72). Premenopausal women: null.
